points.quote: The few bits left carry the MSS
points.problem: The revised prose puts the MSS in the spare bits outside the hash, which is how real SYN cookies work, so the server can read it back. The unrevised Fig 10.11 draws it inside the hash (cookie = hash(secret, A, p, + time bucket + MSS hint)), and its caption says the same. A hash cannot be read back, so figure and prose now disagree.
points.hint: Align Fig 10.11 and its caption: hash of addresses, ports and time bucket, with the MSS bits beside it.
